'
t Nonnetje
is a
restaurant
in
Harderwijk
,
Netherlands
. It is a
fine dining restaurant
that was awarded one
Michelin star
for the periods 2004–2007 and 2009–2014. In 2015 the restaurant was awarded its second
Michelin star
.
[
1

[
2

]
GaultMillau
awarded the restaurant 16 out of 20 points.
[
6
]
The
head chef
of 't Nonnetje is Michel van der Kroft,
[
6
]
who joined the restaurant in 2006 after he left
De Kersentuin
.
[
7
]
He took over from Omar Dahak who had earned the Michelin star in 2004. With the change of head chef the restaurant lost its star, but regained it in 2008.
[
8
]
't Nonnetje has been a member of
Alliance Gastronomique Néerlandaise
since 2009.
